test_title: PYST 66: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

If acid drainage will reaches groundwater, it may persist for decades or centuries.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the phrase "If acid drainage will reaches" is incorrect.
 
• In conditional sentences, the correct structure for the first conditional is "If" + present simple, followed by "will" + base verb.
 
• Therefore, the correct form should be "If acid drainage reaches" instead of "If acid drainage will reaches".

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *If acid drainage reaches groundwater, it may persist for decades or centuries.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Conditional sentences often use specific structures to convey possibilities and hypothetical situations correctly.
 
• Ensuring the proper use of verb tenses in such sentences is crucial for accurate meaning.
 
• Reviewing conditional structures can help avoid common mistakes in complex sentences.
